Updated local audit receipt reviewed: SHA-256 and byte size recorded; observed timestamps outside the fixed half-open interval = 0.
Review provenance trace: manifest is intentionally ignored and has no Git history; producer script is plausible but exact execution linkage is not authenticated.
Independently anchor manifest provenance or explicitly accept it as unanchored acquisition metadata.

Human decision recorded: approve limited DEVELOPMENT tooling use only; provenance remains unanchored; strategy backtests and Fresh Holdout remain prohibited.

manifest_git_tracking.interpretation: Expected local-only storage policy; absence from Git is not evidence of tampering, but also supplies no versioned provenance.

documentation_conflict.observed_statement: The document says this environment cannot access the local MT5 terminal/history and that acquisition must be run on the MT5 host.
documentation_conflict.interpretation: The document may be historical/stale and does not conclusively contradict the later local manifest; neither item independently authenticates the exact acquisition run.

acquisition_provenance_review.conclusion: Human approved limited DEVELOPMENT tooling use only. Keep manifest provenance UNANCHORED_OBSERVED_DIGEST; the producer is plausible, but exact script-version-to-run-to-manifest linkage is not established. This approval does not authorize strategy backtests, Fresh Holdout, canonical geometry, execution/fill certification, or production.
recommended_evidence_if_available: A contemporaneous acquisition command/session log identifying the script revision and output paths.
A trusted, independently retained digest or signed receipt for the manifest and dataset.
Confirmation that the local producer script working tree matches its recorded Git revision.

approved_scope: Limited DEVELOPMENT use for research tooling, audit tooling, schema/fixture engineering, and data-quality diagnostics.
Keep acquisition manifest provenance explicitly UNANCHORED_OBSERVED_DIGEST.
prohibited_scope: Strategy performance backtests or performance-based rule selection.
human_decision.rationale: Human approval is limited to development/tooling use. It does not authenticate acquisition provenance or establish strategy validity.
